questions.stem: Which statement best reflects the route information in the current prescribing label cited for this question?
questions.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"The product label includes both subcutaneous use and an intravenous route under medical supervision with monitoring.","B":"The product label limits use to the subcutaneous route and does not include any intravenous route information.","C":"The product label lists only intramuscular use when a faster clinical response is required for glucose management.","D":"The product label states that all routes are interchangeable and do not require different monitoring considerations."}}
questions.rationale: The cited current label includes subcutaneous use and an intravenous route under medical supervision with close monitoring. Option A matches the source. Options B and C incorrectly restrict the labeled routes, while Option D incorrectly states that routes are freely interchangeable without monitoring differences.
questions.source_name: DailyMed / FDA Label — HUMULIN R (insulin human) injection
questions.source_detail: Eli Lilly label updated May 27, 2025. The prescribing information identifies subcutaneous and intravenous use and specifies medical supervision and close monitoring for the intravenous route.

qc.qc_note: Strict final audit: max/min option-character ratio <=1.15; keyed option within 10% of distractor mean; keyed option is neither shortest nor longest; distractors manually reviewed for clinical plausibility, grammatical parallelism, and answer-cue leakage.
